affected_names: 48 people with accepted Codeforces or CPHOF organization snapshots
issue: Seventy-one roleless Codeforces or CPHOF organization snapshots were labeled current despite containing no dates or chronology.
root_cause: The shared affiliation helper treated every blank end date as ongoing, although competitive-programming directories expose an organization label rather than a dated employment or education interval.
correction: Retained all 71 source-linked organizations as searchable history but removed their unsupported current flags; published destinations are unchanged.
prevention: The history builder now treats roleless dateless Codeforces and CPHOF records as non-chronological, with focused regression coverage and a validation invariant.

issue: Three manually verified rows cited direct IMO contestant IDs that did not match the canonical participation registry; two affected profiles were in the random audit sample.
root_cause: Manual career overlays retained stale or mistyped contestant URLs, while validation checked URL shape and traceability but not person-level agreement with the canonical registry.
correction: Replaced all three URLs with the canonical direct contestant links already attached to each participant record.
prevention: Validation now cross-checks every direct IMO contestant URL in verified evidence against the same person's canonical participation URLs; regression coverage fixes all three IDs.

issue: Four extracted affiliation rows used a date fragment or full degree sentence as the organization; one appeared as a duplicate selected alma mater.
root_cause: Fallback heading recovery accepted organization-shaped text without rejecting embedded date ranges or degree-at-university sentences already represented by a correctly parsed row.
correction: Removed the four malformed rows while retaining the canonical Imperial, RFMS, UNIST, and East Kazakhstan Technical University records.
prevention: The affiliation parser now rejects embedded year ranges and degree-at-institution sentences as organization values; regression coverage and validation scan organization shape.

issue: Askhat's accepted destination source listed HKU and CUHK degrees, but his alma-mater column was empty.
root_cause: Affiliation history extracts accepted LinkedIn and structured adapters automatically, while this reviewed third-party career source had been used only for the destination row.
correction: Added sourced University of Hong Kong master's and Chinese University of Hong Kong bachelor's history records; the official HKU scholarship roster independently corroborates the master's program.
prevention: The random review continues to compare alma-mater output against every accepted destination source, including non-LinkedIn public career profiles.

issue: A third party's LinkedIn page occupied Rakhim's primary-profile field and temporarily removed his parsed Nazarbayev University alma mater.
root_cause: Destination evidence and person-profile identity were conflated in both the review override and the durable career-evidence field; the assembler had no own-profile versus third-party /in/ distinction.
correction: Kept the third-party founder-team page only as destination evidence while publishing Rakhim's own LinkedIn as both profile_url and linkedin_url; Nazarbayev University history and alma mater are restored.
prevention: The assembler now detects differing LinkedIn profile slugs, prefers the alumnus's accepted own profile, and validation plus regression tests reject future third-party profile replacement.

issue: An undated Student headline was published as current Nazarbayev University education even though the same profile dated its bachelor's to 2014-2018 and master's to 2018-2020.
root_cause: The reviewed overlay trusted headline tense without reconciling it against the profile's explicit completed degree dates.
correction: Changed the destination to history-only and retained the sourced 2018-2020 computer-science master's as alma-mater history; the unsupported current Kazakhstan outcome country was removed.
prevention: Validation rejects undated current-education summaries when the same institution has a selected degree ending before the data year.

issue: Candidate namesake affiliations could enter a confirmed person's history.
root_cause: The affiliation filter tested the person's best identity globally instead of requiring a probable or confirmed identity bridge on the affiliation's own source.
correction: Removed unsupported namesake ORCID affiliations and required a source-local identity bridge.
prevention: Dataset validation now rejects every structured affiliation without a probable or confirmed identity on the same source URL.

issue: An active Doctoral Researcher was displayed as employment rather than as a PhD student.
root_cause: The role classifier recognized PhD Student and Doctoral Candidate but not Doctoral Researcher.
correction: Classified active doctoral-researcher roles as education and published Khalifa University / PhD Student in Biomedical Engineering.
prevention: Regression tests distinguish doctoral researchers from postdoctoral researchers; validation rejects active doctoral-researcher employment destinations.

issue: A completed PhD role remained the current destination after the January 2026 defense.
root_cause: The accepted LinkedIn experience heading was stale and no newer official destination review had overridden it.
correction: Superseded the doctoral role with University of Luxembourg / Postdoctoral Researcher from 2026.
prevention: Every extractable LinkedIn current organization must now match the published destination or have an explicit destination/source-precedence review.

issue: DESY was presented as an open-ended current role even though its current staff page lists the person under Alumni.
root_cause: An open-ended ORCID affiliation and the word Scientist outweighed the alumni section semantics.
correction: Bounded the DESY scientist outcome to 2015-2024 and labeled its Hamburg location last verified in 2024.
prevention: Validation rejects alumni-labeled current destinations; historical destination locations carry a last-verified year.

issue: An undated Premix Pro summary displaced an explicit current founder role.
root_cause: The old manual summary had no end date and was therefore ranked as current despite its source not establishing current employment.
correction: Superseded it with MUSAB / CONTROLS / Managing Director and Founder from 2014.
prevention: Accepted-profile current organizations are reconciled against the final destination and unexplained mismatches fail validation.

issue: The profile's Center for Pedagogical Measurements employer did not match its Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools destination.
root_cause: The organization registry lacked the profile's long-form subsidiary-under-parent wording.
correction: Mapped both quoted and unquoted Center for Pedagogical Measurements forms to Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools (NIS).
prevention: A normalization regression test covers the exact public-profile wording; the reconciliation table uses canonical organization names.

affected_names: Aiganym Baltashova;Anton Morgunov;Azamat Abilkhanov;Kairat Akhmetov;Raiymbek Akshulakov;Kairat Zhubayev
issue: Six accepted profiles exposed short programs, stale roles, concurrent roles, or ambiguous overlapping employers that differed from the single published destination.
root_cause: A single destination cannot be selected mechanically when profile headings conflict with newer official evidence or concurrent affiliations.
correction: Recorded an explicit per-person source-precedence decision, retaining active degree status or the strongest newer/current official source.
prevention: Validation requires a destination review or URL-specific outcome decision whenever an accepted profile's parsed current organization differs from the published destination.

issue: The outcome omitted the exact current teaching role and university history despite direct institutional sources.
root_cause: The earlier source set did not combine the employer's current staff report with the university's thesis repository.
correction: Published NIS Physics Teacher as the destination and Nazarbayev University as alma mater with Kazakhstan location evidence.
prevention: Destination and alma-mater builders retain distinct official sources; regression coverage fixes the role and institution.

issue: Two published destinations matched the profile employer but retained a generic or ended role title.
root_cause: Organization-only reconciliation treated a same-employer match as sufficient and did not compare the selected role against dated current profile roles.
correction: Published Anuar's 2024 Sports Financing Model Project consultant role and Nurlan's 2025 WHO Cyprus consultant role.
prevention: The LinkedIn reconciliation now audits current roles separately from organizations and validation rejects unexplained same-employer role mismatches.

issue: Four education records ending in 2026 conflicted with history-only, incoming-university, or post-graduation outcomes.
root_cause: A bounded education record remains active through its graduation year, but dates alone cannot establish whether the person is still enrolled, has graduated, or has a newer destination.
correction: Recorded source-specific decisions preserving two history-only rows, Nurgul's officially confirmed incoming MIT destination, and Rakhim's post-graduation Desargues AI headline.
prevention: Bounded active education now participates in reconciliation and every conflict requires an explicit source-precedence decision.

affected_names: Abylay Shakhizadayev;Aibek Myrzatay;Aigerim Turuspekova;Alexey Tsekhovoy;Alikhan Kudaibergenov;Arman Yesenamanov;Kazhymurat Aknazar;Kuandyk Altynkhanov;Nurlan Zhussipov;Nursultan Pangsat;Rizabek Alpamys;Sanzhar Bidaibek;Shapagat Berdibek;Taiman Sabyrgaliyev;Temirkhan Zimanov;Timur Ratnikov;Ulan Usserkulov;Vyacheslav Kim;Yernar Tursynbay
issue: Nineteen people without a resolved destination inherited a country from a generic profile, historical school, or affiliation record.
root_cause: The location builder ranked career and affiliation country evidence without first gating it by destination status, so stale context could look like a present outcome country.
correction: Removed the nineteen unsupported values; unresolved people now receive a country only from an explicit historical outcome or current research affiliation, while Vyacheslav Kim's new consulting destination intentionally remains country-unknown.
prevention: Regression tests enforce the unresolved-destination evidence allowlist and validation continues to require a direct source for every published country.

issue: Weaker open-ended history rows remained marked current beside source-reviewed bounded outcomes for the same organization.
root_cause: Affiliation deduplication compared exact role and date keys, so a generic manual summary or roleless structured row did not collide with the reviewed destination row.
correction: Destination-review precedence now demotes same-organization manual summaries, roleless records, and alumni rows while preserving a genuinely newer explicit current role.
prevention: A focused regression test covers bounded and later-current records; dataset validation rejects any remaining weaker current row that contradicts a destination review.

issue: Roleless ORCID employment records with neither start nor end dates were labeled current.
root_cause: The shared current-state helper interpreted every blank end date as ongoing, although an undated ORCID affiliation establishes association but not chronology.
correction: Kept the four ORCID affiliations as searchable history but no longer marks them current; dated open ORCID records remain eligible.
prevention: The history builder has a source-specific conservative rule and validation rejects undated roleless ORCID employment marked current.

issue: Three resolved employment destinations displayed an empty role.
root_cause: The destination contract required an organization but allowed a blank role when public profile text exposed only an employer or headline.
correction: Added narrowly sourced descriptive roles: Provincial Government Employee, CoBALT Team Member, and Desargues AI Founding Team Member, with review notes stating where formal titles remain undisclosed.
prevention: Validation now rejects every resolved destination without a role, and the destination-review ledger preserves each descriptive-label rationale and direct source.

issue: Exact-name searches missed Vyacheslav Kim's current outcome because his public career presence uses Slava Kim and the imslavko handle.
root_cause: The first identity pass did not traverse the official IOI-to-CPHOF handle bridge into self-authored profiles and alias forms.
correction: Merged Slava Kim as a reviewed alias and published his self-employed software-engineering consulting destination, MIT degree, and ended Figma history from his handle-linked site.
prevention: Cross-source review now records handle-supported alias merges, while the canonical registry and source ledger retain the official-name and self-authored links.

affected_names: Yerlan Jumabayev;Almas Sakhauyev;Danil Murtazin;Oleg Obukhov;Anton Sedletskiy;Akezhan Askar;Batyr Yerzhanuly
issue: Seven contestants with direct school-to-Olympiad identity bridges remained labeled unmatched because no later career or university destination was known.
root_cause: The verified-evidence contract conflated identity resolution with outcome resolution and could not represent a reviewed person whose destination remained unknown.
correction: Published the seven identities as confirmed while retaining blank organization, role, country, and destination fields; historical school affiliations remain searchable history only.
prevention: The assembler, affiliation builder, audit manifest, and validator now model identity-only evidence separately, prohibit partial blank affiliations, and require identity_verified traceability without final-outcome evidence.

issue: Three tempting exact-name Exa profiles had strong Kazakhstan, subject, or RFMS-adjacent signals but incompatible education chronology.
root_cause: Search ranking over-weighted name, country, and domain continuity without treating tertiary study before a school Olympiad as a hard identity conflict.
correction: Rejected the age-incompatible Akram Makhmudov, young Yerlan Zhumabayev, and older Oleg Obukhov profiles; kept a separate age-plausible Jupiter-K profile deferred because it still lacks an explicit bridge.
prevention: Every old-competitor candidate now receives an education-start chronology check before identity acceptance, and rejected URLs remain source-linked in the audit ledger.

issue: The review generator marked every sampled row pass or pass_after_correction without consuming a persisted review decision.
root_cause: Review status was synthesized from code defaults and a hard-coded correction-note map, so generation itself impersonated manual attestation.
correction: Replaced auto-pass values with a separate decision ledger keyed by seed person and a fingerprint of every displayed claim and source; absent or stale decisions now emit pending.
prevention: Validation rejects pending rows, missing review depth, or missing fingerprints; any destination source country alma mater profile or reconciliation change invalidates the old decision automatically.

issue: AIFC was still published as Daniyar's current destination even though his accepted profile ended both AIFC roles in March 2025.
root_cause: An older undated verified summary overrode the bounded profile chronology, while no reconciliation rule challenged a published open role when the profile parsed only ended employment.
correction: Bounded AIFC history through 2025 and replaced the destination with Contango Trade CEO from AFSA's active February 2026 public register.
prevention: LinkedIn reconciliation now labels an ended matching profile organization against an open published destination unreconciled unless a newer destination review or source-precedence decision exists.

affected_names: Aibatyr Zhumagulov;Almas Rymov;Beket Zhapbasbay;Zhandos Yessenbayev;Nazym Nurlanovna Bashkenova;Sanzhar Orazbayev
issue: Six sampled profiles showed no alma mater although accepted employer university or paper sources explicitly contained postsecondary education.
root_cause: The affiliation builder ingested structured profiles and an explicit manual ledger but did not extract arbitrary biography paragraphs already accepted for destination or identity claims.
correction: Added source-linked university records with cautious credential wording: attendance remains attendance where completion was not stated and all three of Zhandos's degrees are retained separately.
prevention: The fingerprinted sample review now forces education inspection after accepted-source changes; manual affiliation evidence remains the structured auditable bridge for prose-only sources.

issue: The selected destinations were correct but their primary career URLs did not directly state the displayed current role.
root_cause: Identity and location bridge sources had been reused as destination evidence even when a separate official page or accepted profile carried the actual employer and title claim.
correction: Promoted Freedom Telecom's current CEO page and Baurzhan's accepted METAPHORA Technical Lead profile into explicit destination reviews while retaining the prior bridge sources.
prevention: Sample review checks source-to-claim fit separately from logical value agreement; destination reviews make the exact role-bearing source first-class audit evidence.

issue: Sanzhar remained history-only at Khan Group despite a direct Olympiad-linked university paper and a traceable current software-company directorship.
root_cause: The initial pipeline stopped at a roleless Codeforces organization and did not traverse two same-domain GitHub handles through Zapis.kz's full-patronymic registry bridge to UMAG's current director record.
correction: Published UMAG Director as probable with Almaty location and KBTU bachelor's history; every link in the multi-step identity chain is retained in the evidence rationale.
prevention: Handle and personal-domain continuity is now treated as a candidate expansion path, but final publication still requires an independent named bridge and keeps probable confidence when no single source joins Olympiad and current role.

issue: The CUHK country source returned a true 404 during the sampled source-link sweep.
root_cause: The university changed the campus-page slug after the organization-location registry was created and no periodic link audit had refreshed it.
correction: Replaced the dead URL with CUHK's current official campus page without changing the Hong Kong country value.
prevention: The random review includes direct link-status sampling and records anti-bot responses separately from genuine 404s so inaccessible LinkedIn pages are not mislabeled broken.

issue: After the new chronology guard was enabled, three additional published destinations were found to look current despite accepted profiles giving explicit end dates.
root_cause: The final destination could correctly be the latest known historical role, but blank end years in older manual overlays erased the distinction between latest-known and current employment.
correction: Preserved Aset's already bounded 2014-2017 SLB outcome through an explicit review and bounded Temirlan Amangeldinov's Seoul Robotics role to 2022 and Temirlan Baibolov's HARBOUR.SPACE role to 2024; country labels now say last verified.
prevention: Every accepted profile with an ended row matching the selected destination now requires matching bounded output or an explicit newer-source reconciliation.

affected_names: Arman Yesenamanov;Batyr Sardarbekov;Nazarbek Altybay;Nurlan Zhussipov;Parassat Kyzyrkanov;Temirlan Baibolov
issue: Six roleless university labels from competitive-programming directories were selected as alma maters even though the sources proved contest affiliation rather than enrollment or a degree.
root_cause: The alma selector treated a university-shaped organization name as postsecondary education without considering that Codeforces and CPHOF organization fields are undated team metadata.
correction: Kept the source-linked organizations in searchable history but excluded roleless Codeforces and CPHOF rows from alma-mater selection; independently dated LinkedIn and manual degree rows remain eligible.
prevention: The affiliation classifier now has a source-specific competition-directory gate with regression coverage, mirroring the existing conservative chronology rule for these sources.

issue: Batyr's accepted LinkedIn profile had no education section, while the prior alma values came only from roleless CPHOF metadata.
root_cause: Validation correctly expected education review for an accepted public profile but the source parser had no legitimate degree row to select after directory metadata was demoted.
correction: Added IITU student history from the university's official rector report and Harbour.Space Bachelor in Computer Science from its official ICPC team biography.
prevention: Missing-alma validation remains strict for accepted profiles; when a profile omits education, independent institutional evidence must supply enrollment or credential wording rather than re-promoting contest metadata.

issue: Three agricultural degree rows from an exact-name ORCID were displayed as the Olympiad alumna's alma maters despite her independently sourced MIT-to-EPFL computer-science timeline.
root_cause: The structured-source scorer promoted an exact-name ORCID from Kazakhstan context and a superficially plausible age without comparing its degree chronology against the accepted public profile; downstream affiliation selection then treated every probable ORCID education row as belonging to the same person.
correction: Rejected ORCID 0009-0009-3827-8634 for the Olympiad alumna and retained only her sourced MIT mathematics degree and EPFL computer-science PhD.
prevention: Validation now rejects a selected structured-source alma mater when it overlaps a separately trusted selected degree at a different normalized institution for at least two years, unless the structured institution itself has trusted corroboration.
